blocks.text: A short update on the board search for {{fact:f:E-2017-001.client}}. The market map is built, and we have begun reading the strongest prospects against the specification we agreed. We approach a first group of prospective directors this week. Two prospects I did not expect have already surfaced, which is the part of this work I enjoy most. The specification is holding well against the market, which is a good sign this early, and as throughout we describe candidates by their current seat, not by name. None of the strongest names has ruled itself out.

The team on this is steady. I am your day-to-day contact on the research, Jason Bell, with James Grant leading the assessment and Jeffrey Patterson keeping the candidate conversations and scheduling in hand. No thread is going quiet, and you will have a fuller written status from us shortly. If a name ever needs your steer, James will bring it to you himself.

One ask, so that we do not lose time later. When the slate is ready, your board's interview availability will set our pace. Could you hold two provisional windows over the coming weeks? I will have Jeffrey firm them up as candidates confirm, and he will work through you alone, Jennifer Frazier, so that nothing about the search travels wider than it should. Even rough placeholders help; we can confirm the times later as candidates lock in.
